claims.text: The hotel sits on a two and a half-hectare site along the Perfume River.

findings.quote: Set on a two and a half-hectare site along the legendary Perfume River

claims.text: The hotel is on the banks of the Perfume River, just upstream from Hue's citadel.

findings.quote: Built on the banks of the Perfume River just upstream from Hue’s famous citadel

claims.text: The colonial mansion at the heart of the hotel was built in the 1930s as part of the residence of the French Resident Superieure.

findings.quote: The colonial mansion at the heart of the resort was built in 1930s as part of the residence of the French Resident Superieure.

claims.text: The mansion's facade, with long horizontal lines and nautical flourishes, is a hallmark of the streamline moderne school of art deco architecture.

findings.quote: The mansion’s distinctive façade, its long horizonal lines and nautical flourishes are hallmark of the streamline moderne school of art deco architecture.

claims.text: Two contemporary wings, built in 2005, echo art deco aesthetics and embrace a tropical garden and a salt-water swimming pool.

findings.quote: Its two complementary wings, built in 2005, are contemporary in design yet echo elements of art deco aesthetics and embrace an expansive tropical garden and salt-water swimming pool.

claims.text: The salt-water pool lies on the far side of the garden, parallel to the river, edged by shaded sun loungers.

findings.quote: The resort’s salt-water pool stretches 40 meters on the far side of the garden and parallels the river. Shaded sun loungers edge the pool.

claims.text: Rooms in the original villa have a colonial feel, with ceiling fans, mosquito netting and dark-stained wood furnishings.

findings.quote: These have a colonial feel, with ceiling fans, mosquito netting (for atmosphere more than necessity), and dark-stained wood furnishings.

claims.text: Deluxe River View rooms open onto a private sun terrace with views of the Perfume River.

findings.quote: DELUXE RIVER VIEW
opening out onto a private sun terrace with stunning views of the Perfume River

claims.text: The Monument d'Egypte Suite is infused with Egyptian-inspired elements and opens onto a large veranda with tropical garden.

findings.quote: A spacious suite infused with Egyptian-inspired elements, opening out onto a large veranda with tropical garden.

claims.text: The fitness centre has TechnoGym treadmills, exercise bikes, an elliptical trainer and strength equipment.

findings.quote: The all-new fitness centre is equipped with TechnoGym treadmills, exercise bikes, an elliptical trainer and strength equipment

claims.text: The original villa's reception is decorated with framed photos of Old Hue, next to a bar with deep club chairs.

findings.quote: The original villa includes a reception area decorated with framed photos of Old Hue and an adjacent bar with deep club chairs

claims.text: The heart of the hotel is a 1930s colonial mansion, built as part of the French Resident Superieure's residence, in streamline moderne art deco style.

findings.quote: The colonial mansion at the heart of the resort was built in 1930s as part of the residence of the French Resident Superieure.
hallmark of the streamline moderne school of art deco architecture

claims.text: The Resident Suite occupies the entire top floor of the original governor's mansion and opens onto a veranda with a 360 degree view.

findings.quote: Our most spacious suite occupies the entire top floor of the original governor’s mansion, opening out onto an enormous veranda with a 360 degree view.

claims.text: The hotel stands on the banks of the Perfume River, just upstream from Hue's citadel.

findings.quote: Built on the banks of the Perfume River just upstream from Hue’s famous citadel

claims.text: A salt-water pool runs parallel to the river on the far side of the tropical garden.

findings.quote: The resort’s salt-water pool stretches 40 meters on the far side of the garden and parallels the river.
embrace an expansive tropical garden and salt-water swimming pool

claims.text: The original governor's mansion is a two-story building with a grand staircase and no lift.

findings.quote: this historic two-story residence retains its timeless elegance, including its grand staircase—please note there is no lift.

claims.text: Deluxe Colonial rooms in the mansion have a city view rather than a river view.

findings.quote: A colonial style deluxe room located in the mansion, with a city view.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes limited nearby nightlife and a humid tropical climate.
